rows.definition: One role's resolved routing for a single execution: the modelroute Plan chosen, the budget it runs under, spend against it, whether exhausted and on which axis, and any role it escalated to.
rows.distinction: Scoped to one role inside a RoleEnvelope; unlike Decision (kernel) it is not the whole run's verdict, and unlike RouteDecision (guardroute) it decides model+budget delegation for a role, not a guard admit/refuse.

rows.definition: The static dense k-quant residency decision fak model preflight derives from the declared CUDA device-op table and target arch - which dense quant types stay resident on-device instead of re-quantizing to Q8_0 - feeding the same options function serve uses.
rows.distinction: Not the live-backend probe behind serveDenseKQuantOptions (which reads a real compute.Backend at serve time), and not ggufload q4kLoadOptions (the loader-side option struct); it is a frozen capability description shared by preflight classification and serve option emission.
